To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the education level of migrants is higher than that of non-migrants, and that the education level is positively correlated with the probability of migrating.
education in Ukraine is not a sufficient factor to guarantee employment in the domestic labour force and that the probability of migration increases with the level of education.
education is the main factor influencing the decisions of Ukrainians to migrate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of education in the context of the migration of highly skilled workers and its impact on the development of Ukraine.
the role of education in the migration process in Ukraine and the role of remittances in the education system.
the role of education in shaping the decisions of individuals in relation to migration and employment in the domestic labour markets.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the level of education of a person in Ukraine has a significant influence on the probability of emigration, the choice of country of destination, the type of job and the legal status of the person in the country of destination.
the education sector in Ukraine has a significant impact on migration and that this impact is positive.
education in Ukraine is a key factor in the decision to migrate and in the choice of destination country and occupation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
education is a key determinant of the decision to migrate and of the destination country, and that the impact of remunances on education in the country of origin is limited.
education is an important factor in the decisions of migrants, and that the impact of education is stronger on decisions to migrate than on the choice of destination country.
the education system in Ukraine is not sufficiently adapted to meet labour market demands and the education system is not able to produce enough skilled workers to meet labour demand in the country.
The main takeaway from our work is that
education is a significant determinant of migration, and that migration is a significant determinant for education in Ukraine.
the education system in Ukraine is not well adapted to the labour market.
there are strong links between migration and education in Ukraine, and that education is a major driver of migration decisions.
